load_offloaded_model: load a large language model with disk offloading using load_offloaded_model context manager
get_device_map: get the device map of an offloaded model to verify which devices it is dispatched to
quantize_model_nvfp4: quantize a language model to NVFP4 format using QuantizationModifier and oneshot
calibrate_model: calibrate a quantized model using a dataset with oneshot and QuantizationModifier
save_compressed_model: save a quantized model and tokenizer to disk in compressed format
